blocks.existing: Native PHP-FPM defaults remain global; automatic account runtime caps borrow available shared capacity rather than reserving workers for idle accounts. Tuning values come from the reviewed generator profile, not this help page. Configured vs Effective Audit separates the private FPM ceiling from the current concurrent relay grant. A partial grant advertises queued demand and can grow in place without a PHP/OPcache restart. Fair-share reductions hold new work in the bounded queue and wait for forwarded work and verified backend idleness before re-admission. Root-only backend sockets and a PID/start-token proxy handshake prevent bypass and preserve compatibility with older running proxies. Warm masters retain OPcache while headroom permits, with a hardware-derived maximum idle duration; eligible peer demand or low host reserve can reclaim a quiescent lease early. Ondemand workers still retire using inherited global defaults. The native cgroup service uses a plugin-owned coexistence drop-in, preserving the vendor script and managed service descendants.
